name: Slaying Dragons with AI
summary: A hands-on session built with Franziska-J. Klebôn: participants build a working local AI agent system on their own laptop inside an hour, then point it at a future-self goal-setting exercise. Run so far with Tomorrow University in Berlin, and next with the WAVE Fellowship and HeadsQuarter in Zurich.
highlights: Berlin Immersion: 60 minutes, 40 attendees, four working prototypes — and a write-up that is honest about the other thirty-six
Prerequisites are deliberately low: a laptop and any AI tool that can reach local files

name: Writing
summary: Sixteen pieces, from design-thinking essays written as Sebastian Rappen to recent work on Azure AI Foundry, data mesh and where AI investment actually pays. Everything published on limmatreframe.com and LinkedIn now lives here.
